title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lab
subtitle: Practice the decisions between an ambiguous request and an ownable production path
description: A provider-neutral guided lab course for practicing evidence-led discovery, bounded implementation, failure diagnosis, release and recovery, stabilization, and customer ownership with a fully synthetic deployment.
author: Komal Nakrani
prerequisites: Comfort reading JavaScript modules and command-line test output.
Familiarity with APIs, data contracts, authorization, testing, and production operations.
A local Node.js 20 or newer runtime; no cloud account or external service is required.
outcomes: Convert an underspecified request into a bounded outcome, authority map, and evidence plan.
Diagnose contract, identity, data, policy, model, dependency, and reconciliation failures without hiding unknown state.
Assemble verification, telemetry, release, recovery, and readiness evidence into an explicit disposition.
Run a synthetic incident and transfer operation, access, decisions, change, and support without retaining hidden dependency.
Defend a complete capstone dossier while preserving limitations and rejecting unsupported production claims.
certificationPolicy: Optional Komal learning material. Not required by Abhyaas. NOT FOR LIVE CERTIFICATION BANK.

modules.title: Frame a Deployed Outcome
modules.summary: Turn a chatbot-shaped request into a bounded workflow claim, authority map, discovery plan, and stop conditions.

modules.title: Bind the Real Boundary
modules.summary: Trace a representative intent through contracts, identity, data, environment, dependencies, ownership, and controlled failure.

modules.title: Bound AI and Prove Behavior
modules.summary: Place a model inside deterministic policy, qualified approval, segmented evaluation, traceable verification, and explicit limitations.

modules.title: Operate, Release, and Recover
modules.summary: Connect promise-linked signals to diagnosis, progressive release, migration evidence, restoration, and an honest recovery rehearsal.

modules.title: Stabilize and Transfer Ownership
modules.summary: Work inside accountable incident command, correct systemic conditions, diagnose adoption friction, and prove customer capability and access exit.

modules.title: Defend the Deployment Dossier
modules.summary: Integrate the course evidence into a capstone disposition, ownership decision, reuse boundary, and portfolio-level communication.
